title: Salaami sooe maqtal sayyade abraar aate hai
body:
Salami Suve Maqtal Syed-E- Abraar Aate hai
Hathe-Li Par Dhare Sar Khalq Ke Sardaar aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hamaare Khwaab Me Jab Syed-E- Abraar aate hai
Mubaarak Baad Dene Taala-E Bedaar aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jigar Me Dard Lab Par Aah Aansoo Dono Aankhou'n Me
Bade Saamaan Se hazrath Ke Matamdaar aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Is aane ke fida kis shaan se ran me hussain aaye
yuhi aate hai bas marne ko jo tayyar aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Qayaale Shaah-E Waala Me Dil-E Muztar Yeh Kehta Hai
Uth Aye Dard-E Jigar Taazeem Ko Sarkaar aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sawaari Hai Yeh Akbar Ki Ke Qudrath Ka Namoona Hai
Shabaahath Keh Rahi Hai Ahmad-E Mukhtaar aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bade Faiyaaz hai Yeh Rone Waale Bhi Ke Majlis Me
Jab aate hai Lutaane Gowhar-E Shehwaar aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Abhi Khaime Se Nikle Bhi Na The Ghul Machgayaa Run Me
Alambardaar aate hai Alambardaar aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Andheri Raat Me Banu Yehi Keh-Keh Ke Roti Thi
Ke Akbar Yaad Tere Chand Se Rukhsaar aate hai
